description:
As an operator choosing the system default model, and a person chatting
  I want a change of model to apply to the next answer without a restart,
  and to see which model answered, why, and since when
  So that I can trust the model I chose is the model that served the reply

elements.name: Clearing an override shows what the conversation will inherit

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the system default model is "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
a conversation "Chat X" with the model override "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo"
I clear the model override of this conversation
the preview says this conversation will answer with "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku" from "system default"
I cancel the change
I send the message "S1 r4 cancel"
the reply to "S1 r4 cancel" came from "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo"
I clear the model override of this conversation
I confirm the change
I send the message "S1 r4 confirm"
the reply to "S1 r4 confirm" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the answer's receipt names "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku" and the origin "system default"
